What to Know About the Case Behind Netflix's New True-Crime Docuseries The Trials of Karen Read

On Jan. 29, 2022, Boston police officer John O’Keefe, 46, was found dead in the snow outside of his friend’s home in Canton, Mass. His girlfriend, Karen Read , was arrested and accused of second-degree murder and manslaughter, with authorities alleging that she ran over O’Keefe in her SUV while driving under the influence, then left him in the snow to die.
